description.en: Norway, officially the Kingdom of Norway, is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, the remote Arctic island Jan Mayen and the archipelago of Svalbard. Bouvet Island, located in the Subantarctic, is a dependency, and not a part of the Kingdom; Norway also claims the Antarctic territories of Peter I Island and Queen Maud Land.
description.zh-CN: 挪威，全称挪威王国，是一个位于斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北欧国家。挪威本土位于欧洲大陆西北部，涵盖北极地区的扬马延岛和斯瓦尔巴群岛，此外还在南大西洋还拥有布韦岛。
description.zh-TW: 挪威，全稱挪威王國，是一個位於斯堪的納維亞半島的北歐國家。挪威本土位於歐洲大陸西北部，涵蓋北極地區的揚馬延島和斯瓦爾巴羣島，此外還在南大西洋還擁有布韋島。
